name: godmode-trader
description: The GODMODE multi-asset trader skill pack for Claude

plugins.name: godmode-trader
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for forex, commodities, indices and crypto: a chart scanner, a news monitor, an economic calendar with news blackouts, an entry timer and an exit planner (long and short, every session), a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a budget manager in lots and contracts, a risk manager with leverage, margin and currency exposure, an order executor for OANDA, Alpaca, MT5, cTrader and IBKR (paper by default, never without your yes), price alerts with a world market clock, and a COT positioning tracker.
